grid_cutoff.per_system_override_rule: Keep the response real-space grid cutoff consistent with the ABACUS ecutwfc.
grid_cutoff.rationale: The Sternheimer response grid must match the mean-field grid or the response is inconsistent.

nfreq.per_system_override_rule: Use a dense frequency grid for the RPA correlation energy.
nfreq.rationale: The RPA correlation energy integral converges slowly in frequency.

pca_threshold.per_system_override_rule: Loosen the auxiliary-basis PCA threshold for solids, whose auxiliary sets are large.
pca_threshold.rationale: A tight PCA threshold on a large solid auxiliary basis is expensive without improving accuracy.

coulomb_metric.per_system_override_rule: Use the full Coulomb metric; the cut metric is diagnostic-only and must not be used for production.
coulomb_metric.rationale: The cut Coulomb is not the physical metric; substituting it changes the RPA correlation energy.

kq_sampling.per_system_override_rule: Keep the k/q sampling regular and Gamma-centred, matching the SCF mesh.
kq_sampling.rationale: The k and q sums must use a consistent regular mesh.
